dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: GOD DAMN IT. THAT'S IT! YOU'RE GOING DOWN NOW FUCK HEAD. You had ONE chance, and you fucking BLEW IT! SHOW OFF.

dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: Woah woah woahhh... lucy, right? Look, even though he kinda tore yo ass up, he was kinda spitting the truth there a bit. If you just listen to us for a minute, we can explain things a bit more clearly!

dialogue.name: Girlfriend
dialogue.text: Yeah! I agree with both of them, just give us one more chance! This time we'll work with you-

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: Shut. The Fuck. UP.

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: You fucking dirty criminals are all the damn same. Always tryna squeeze your damn way out of every fucking thing you commit. I can't believe I let my guard down to even listen to what your stupid ass had to say.

dialogue.name: Girlfriend
dialogue.text: Lucy, please... hear us out. W- we're not trying to make things more difficult than it has to be! Please understand that this entire thing started with that white chick! She was a super huge fan of ours!

dialogue.name: Girlfriend
dialogue.text: She had devised this entire stalker-ish and creepy plan to get powers and use it against me to get my man. These fans can be really insane, you never really know what their intentions are, and for us... Well, we had to learn it the hard way in the end.

dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: You might not even believe this part but, she actually... how do I say this. She... *murdered* all of us. Right, boyfriend?

dialogue.name: Boyfriend
dialogue.text: **snoring**

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: Fucking bullshit ass excuses, do you really think I'd believe anything out of your goddamn mouthes? 'Oh i died! This girl magically got demon powers!' If you're gonna tell me a fucking bedtime story at least be good at it-

dialogue.name: Girlfriend
dialogue.text: We found this. Someone managed to capture the entire thing on their phone before they were killed too. When she was finally killed, that's when things reverted back to normal.

dialogue.name: Girlfriend
dialogue.text: It's pretty grim stuff, but we can also see why you would think she was the only one murdered. I regonized that purple auora, it was my mom who stupidly decided to give her powers, thinking this would finally put an end to everything.

dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: She shot at Nova but the bullet grazed his head, knocking him out but killing the rest of us. He woke up and stepped in to try to stop things. If we weren't there at the time, who knows what would've really happened.

dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: The same fan who recorded this, sent this to us privately. We knew if we'd try to report this to the police, no one would believe us, because why would they? Still kept it just in case.

dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: It all sounds so silly, like a movie or something. But we knew her dead body would be out there somewhere, and we didn't exactly know what to do so we just... ran.

dialogue.name: Girlfriend
dialogue.text: That's when Jasmine, Boyfriend, and Nova decided to come look for me. I was taken away and sent to my parents before anything serious went down. I got locked away.

dialogue.name: Girlfriend
dialogue.text: I couldn't do anything to stop it... me and that girl shared the same powers but somehow I couldn't use mine against hers?

dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: And when we did find her, we broke her out because we felt as if this whole thing by 'separating the couple away from each other' was so lame. We thought the best thing to do was to-

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: ...run away and hide. Alright. Alright... Alright, I get it. Damn it. I just wished you guys tried harder to reach out for help, running away from your problems is never the answer. But I guess, when you're desperate and don't know what to do, you don't think straight...

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: Perhaps... I judged you a bit too harshly. I presume the real perpetrators are the Dearests, manipulating people and sending them on death missions. Who really knows what else they are up to. Girlfriend, you got some shitty ass parents.

dialogue.name: Girlfriend
dialogue.text: Yah. I know.

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: And uh... I'm... Imsorryjasmineididntmeanthestuffblarghblarg....

dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: What? You kinda mumbled there.

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: I SAID... I'M... sorryjasmineididntmeanblarghblargh... OKAY?

dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: Nope, still couldn't hear you. Could you say it a bit louder and clearer into my ear?

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: Whatever, man. You're... mmm... you're very pretty, in your own way. I guess.

dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: Mmmmhmmm... Okayyy... anyways look, I know the air in here is really stuffy with all the anger, misunderstanding, and other shit. How about we just lay back and do another karaoke, huh?

dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: It's really fun! Drinks are on me! Oh waiter! Pour me up 4 more shots! I'd say 5 but I think boyfriend had way too much already, haha!

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: Ugh, you know what, fuck it. I could use a damn drink, this line of work is pretty stressful. I'll compensate things by hanging with you guys. But after this, we gotta talk more about this situation, 'Nova'... as they say.
